limitations: Reachability only: a call path from main or init to a symbol does not show that the vulnerable behaviour can be triggered or exploited.
Analysed for this machine's GOOS/GOARCH with CGO_ENABLED=0 and no build tags; other build configurations can differ.
Calls made only through reflect or unsafe can be missed by the call graph; a NOT_REACHABLE needs the linker method to agree (symbol absent from the binary), which guards against that (CP2).

Mode 2 checks only the retriever's top None candidates (CANDIDATE_LEVEL): REACHABLE means one of them is reachable, not that the vulnerable function is; the candidate list missed the root cause in about 16-19% of D4 cases (CP4-CP6).
12 main package(s) over the limit of 10 were not analysed, so NOT_REACHABLE cannot be concluded for this app.

policy.name: MODE2_NOT_REACHABLE_POLICY
policy.rule: Mode 2 checks only the retriever's top-k candidates, and the candidate list misses the root cause in a measured share of cases, so a Mode 2 NOT_REACHABLE only says that none of the analysed candidates is reachable. It is reported as CANT_DETERMINE with MODE2_NOT_REACHABLE_DOWNGRADED; the raw verdict is kept in pre_policy_verdict.

statement: Reachability only. This verdict does not assess exploitability.
